remarks: Welcome to 154 Cold Spring - a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2 full bath top-floor home offering the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and peaceful surroundings. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully renovated interior with a seamless flow, generous living space, and the convenience today's buyers are looking for - including in-unit laundry. The top-floor location provides added privacy and an abundance of natural light throughout. One of the true highlights? A screened-in porch overlooking the tranquil river, creating the perfect setting to unwind with your morning coffee or relax in the evening while enjoying the calming sounds of the water. Additional features include a carport plus an extra dedicated parking space, along with ample visitor parking for guests.A rare combination of updated finishes, serene outdoor space, and everyday convenience - all in a desirable setting.
